evidence.clarity: 1440/390 first screen: H1 'Plan the week's dinners from the fridge, not the store.' with the lede 'Pantrywise is a free iPhone app for parents of picky kids. A visitor gets what, who and next step in two lines.
evidence.fit: All 5 waitlist links use the supplied URL. The picky-kid tension is built into the demo ('The kids won't eat': No mushrooms / Nothing spicy / Nothing mixed in), and the price is handled as 'Free' plus a dashed 'Later' family-plan card with 'The price isn't set'. Small mismatch: 'seven weeknight dinners' while the plan runs Mon-Sun.
evidence.distinctiveness: Fridge-magnet details (a red magnet pinning the 'This week' sheet), custom inline SVG grocery icons on the chips, a Bookman/Charter display serif and the 'Max, 6' / 'Nora, 9' no-list notes are product-specific. The overall skeleton (nav, hero, 3 steps, price cards, accordion FAQ, CTA band) is familiar.
evidence.proof: 1440: the shelf panel and the top of the plan sheet are in the first viewport (shelf at y about 450). From the default state, ticking 'Nothing spicy' swapped Shakshuka for 'Chicken noodle soup' and the status changed to '6 things to buy'. 'Nothing mixed in' added 'KIDS plain omelette, spinach beside it' rows without changing the list, matching the copy 'the picky kid costs nothing extra'. The second list in #list mirrors the shelf live. It is labelled 'A sample fridge' in the panel header and 'Sample shelf, sample dinners' under the list.
evidence.craft:
axe: 0 violations at 390 and 1440 (probe and my run). CTA white on #D63A1C is 4.69:1 and the ink focus ring on yolk is strong. CSS has full tokens (spacing scale --s-1..9, radii, colours) and reduced-motion branches. Against that: 23 text elements at 11px (uppercase .k labels USES/BUY/KIDS, 'use soon'); one 48KB HTML with inline CSS/JS and '' prerendered markup whose build step is not delivered, so editing planner.js data leaves the static HTML stale; VETOES and excludedCount are unused; checkbox groups have no fieldset/legend ('On the shelf' and 'The kids won't eat' are

); 2 inline style attributes; the display font relies on locally installed TeX Gyre Bonum/Bookman/Charter.
evidence.mobile: 390/320: 0px overflow, and every interactive element is at least 44px (my target scan found none smaller; shelf chips 54px tall in 2 columns, 1 column under 360px). The Menu opens, Escape closes it and returns focus to the button, and tapping 'Picky eaters' scrolls there and closes it. But tapping outside or tabbing past the last link leaves the menu open over the H1. Tapping 'Chicken thighs' (chip y=775) updates a status line about 650px lower, off-screen.
evidence.honesty: Examples are labelled where they appear: 'A sample fridge. Tap what you have.' at the top of the demo, 'Example' captions on the 3 step minis, 'Example no-list' on Max/Nora. 'One email address, and we write when the app is ready' sits beside the CTA before the click. The footer says 'Contact details and a privacy policy arrive with the app.' Minor: 'so most of the week is already paid for' implies savings by wording, and 'seven weeknight dinners' includes weekends.
evidence.interaction: The checkboxes are real <input type=checkbox> wrapped in labels, the visible focus ring is drawn on the chip via :has(:focus-visible), and Space toggles. Untick all gives 'Nothing on the shelf. Tick at least one thing you have, or this week is just a shopping trip.' and the status 'Nothing on the shelf, so no plan yet.' Only yogurt gives 'Only 2 dinners fit...'. 'Put the sample back' restores 9 items and clears the vetoes. Enter does not submit the form. The role=status line announces a one-line summary and changed rows flash. Weak spots: a veto with no effect (e.g. No mushrooms on the default shelf) gives no feedback; unticked shelf items show up on the list as 'leftover rice' / 'half a bag of spinach'; the menu doesn't close on outside click. No console errors. With JS off, the prerendered plan still shows.
evidence.copy: Customer-world nouns and good microcopy: 'Put the sample back', 'Picky eaters get a veto, not a lecture.', 'Rice, egg and peas, in three piles', 'Big tick targets, because you're holding a basket.' The edge-state copy 'buy leftover rice' is odd, and it says 'weeknight' while planning 7 days.
evidence.first_screen: 1440: a specific outcome for a named audience, the CTA, and the top of the live shelf demo are in one viewport, with the plan sheet only just starting. 390: promise, audience, CTA and the honest note about the price not being set are in view, but no artifact appears until the shelf panel at about y=630, below the 844 fold.

problems: Maintainability: the prerendered plan and list in index.html depend on a missing build step ('build:' markers) and duplicate planner.js output, VETOES and excludedCount are dead, and everything is inlined into one 48KB HTML.
Mobile menu stays open on outside click and when focus tabs past its last link, covering the H1 at 390; the demo's feedback (status line) lands about 650px below the tapped chip.
23 text elements at 11px (uppercase USES/BUY/KIDS labels), checkbox groups without fieldset/legend, and edge-state list copy like 'leftover rice' to buy.

reason: B is the page I would rather maintain and be on call for: no axe violations, 44px targets throughout, a reset path, readable empty/short states, a concise status live region, and content that still renders with JS off. A fails contrast on its own CTA and has no reset, under-size targets and a noisy live region. What would change my mind: if B's missing build step meant the prerendered HTML could not be kept in sync, though even then its runtime behaviour is better.
